messages:
Alex P: Heads-up team: we need a 60m design review to sign off the Batch Inference endpoints (API + SDK + Console UX). Goal: validate API schema, SDK migration path, console flows, and perf constraints so we can cut an alpha next sprint. Please vote on two proposed slots and review the pre-read when I post it.

Maria K: +1. Prefer morning PST. I can own the API walkthrough and ship the pre-read doc (will add schema diffs + example payloads).

Tim L: Morning works. Can you include expected QPS and a simple load profile in the pre-read? Infra needs to confirm tail-latency targets and cache behavior.

Sara J: Ill demo console flows and sketch the migration UX. Also want a short checklist of any Console flags or feature gates we need for rollout.

Alex P: Proposed slots: 
- Tue 09:00-10:00 PT
- Thu 10:00-11:00 PT
If one slot gets majority well lock it. Pre-read link (draft): https://docs.google.com/example/batch-infer-pre-read 
Contains: goals, API spec, SDK diffs, console mockups, perf targets, rollout plan, migration checklist. Add comments directly.

Maria K: Pre-read checklist suggestion (add to doc):
- Read goals + success criteria
- Confirm API schema (endpoints, request/response samples)
- Run SDK sample locally (see snippet below)
- Walk through console mockups and confirm flows
- Perf targets + test harness link
- Back-compat risk and mitigation
- Security & data handling notes (Jin)

Tim L: Add items: expected QPS, concurrency per-worker, KV cache odds/ends, SLO targets for p50/p95/p99, and which infra metrics to surface. Ill attach a perf harness link.

Sara J: SDK/local run snippet for the pre-read (put this in the doc):
```
pip install redwood-sdk==0.14.0
python -c "from redwood import BatchClient; c=BatchClient(); print(c.ping())"
```
And a quick curl example for API smoke test:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/batch -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"inputs": ["hello","world"]}'
```
(This should return 200 with job id).

Alex P: Mandatory reviewers: @Maria K, @Tim L, @Sara J, @Jin H. Jin  can you confirm you can join one of the slots and glance at KMS/data handling notes in the pre-read?

DesignBot: calendar: draft event "Batch Inference: API+SDK+Console design review" created: Tue 09:00-10:00 PT and Thu 10:00-11:00 PT. RSVP link: https://calendar.example/evt/xyz789

Jin H: Im OOO Tue morning, Thu 10:00 PT clashes with another customer sync. I can do Thu 11:00-12:00 PT but thats tight. If we must pick, Thu 10:00-11:00 is risky for me; prefer Tue. Ill skim the pre-read for KMS and data retention text.

Maria K: Vote: Tue 09:00-10:00 PT (thumbs up emoji). If Jins out we can record and do async sign-off for security items.

Tim L: +1 Tue 09:00. Ill add perf harness and sample JMeter script link to the doc by EOD Mon.

Sara J: +1 Tue 09:00. Ill upload a 3m console walkthrough clip to the doc and annotate mockups with interaction notes.

Chris M: I can run SDK snippets Monday morning and paste results here. If anything breaks Ill open a quick PR.

Nina R: Ill review console mockups Mon afternoon and flag any accessibility concerns.

Alex P: Consensus: Tue 09:00-10:00 PT, 60m. Action items:
- Maria: finalize API schema section + examples
- Tim: attach perf harness + infra metrics list
- Sara: demo clip + console annotated flows
- Jin: review KMS/data handling notes (async if needed)
- Chris & Nina: run SDK + UX checks and report back
Everyone: add comments to pre-read by Mon 17:00 PT.

DesignBot: event updated/locked: Tue 09:00-10:00 PT, attendees: Alex P, Maria K, Tim L, Sara J, Jin H (tentative), Chris M, Nina R. Reminders: 24h and 15m. Recording enabled.

Alex P: Final note  please mark the pre-read checkbox once youve completed it in the doc. Well treat the meeting as blocked for approvals only if reviewers mark done. Use this thread for quick coordination only. Thanks everyone :rocket:
